chunked.content:
Hantec Research: My Key Takeaways

I found Hantecâs research content to be high quality and well-presented, but itâs missing a few critical components. The economic calendar and InsightPro tool stand out for their actionable trading signals, making them especially useful for day traders.

However, Hantec no longer provides in-depth market reviews that explain the underlying reasons behind price movements. Additionally, the absence of a news screener makes it more challenging for traders to stay up-to-date on the latest market developments in real-time.

Education

Hantec stands out in the education category with its excellent collection of articles and guides covering the fundamentals of technical analysis, fundamental analysis, and trading psychology. The broker also provides a variety of educational videos and recorded webinars, offering valuable learning materials for traders at different levels. The content is broad and diverse, though it could benefit from a clearer structure.

On its website, Hantec also hosts a comprehensive Education section filled with trading articles and guides. These materials go beyond the basics, offering readers practical insights into reading price action, understanding market behavior, and implementing effective risk management strategies.

I also reviewed Hantecâs YouTube channel and was impressed by its extensive library of educational content and past webinars. The broker has published 17 MetaTrader 4 tutorials, 12 how-to videos that guide users through account setup and social trading, and 34 videos from the âTrader Talksâ series, which feature insightful interviews with market experts sharing valuable perspectives on trading.

Additionally, I found 144 past webinars covering key topics such as technical and fundamental analysis, trading psychology, and risk managementâall explained in great detail. My only criticism is that Hantec has stopped releasing new content, which limits ongoing engagement.

The Bottom Line

Hantec Markets stands out as a well-established, multi-regulated broker with licenses from top-tier authorities, including the FCA and ASIC. With tight spreads, low trading costs, and a broad selection of over 2,650 instruments, it offers strong appeal to both casual and copy traders seeking stability and value.

The broker caters to traders of all experience levels through its sophisticated Hantec WebTrader, which is also available via mobile. The Hantec platform delivers advanced charting tools and a more modern, user-friendly interface than MetaTrader, which is also supported. Additionally, Hantec has developed a dedicated social and copy trading app, allowing traders to follow and replicate the strategies of others with ease.

The broker also excels in education, offering comprehensive articles, guides, and webinars that cover every major aspect of trading. However, its market research offering lacks the same depth and variety, limiting analytical insight for more advanced traders.

Overall, Hantec Markets is an excellent choice for beginners and intermediate traders who value strong regulation, affordable trading conditions, and quality education. Still, itâs worth noting that scalping is not permitted, and Islamic (swap-free) accounts are currently unavailable.

When reviewing a broker, we examine how each of its entities is regulated and assess how effectively they protect clients. We use a three-tier system to rank regulatory bodies, with Tier-1 being the most trusted and offering the highest level of protection.

How Does Headway Protect You?

I reviewed the brokerâs client agreement and risk disclosure to examine how Headway protects its clients. These documents can be accessed from the âAbout Usâ tab on the Headway website, under the âLegal Documentsâ section.

Here is what I found about Jarocel (Pty) Ltd:

â Segregated Accounts â Client funds are kept separate from the companyâs own capital.

â Negative Balance Protection â Your losses cannot exceed your invested capital.

â Compensation Scheme â In the unlikely event of insolvency, you will not be entitled to insurance.

To learn more about the most important safety mechanisms and how they apply to you, check our dedicated guide on client protections.

Stability and Transparency

We also assess a brokerâs stability and transparency. This includes how long the company has been in business, its size, and how openly it shares information about its business and services.

I reviewed Headwayâs website and social media channels and discovered that the broker is a relative newcomer to the trading scene, having been established in 2022. According to the brokerâs LinkedIn page, it employs about 40 professionals, which is pretty standard for the industry.

I also checked Headwayâs client agreement and risk disclosure. For the most part, I found that Headway maintains clear and transparent operations. Its legal documents are readily available, concise, and cover all relevant information about the companyâs standard practices, as well as clientsâ rights, obligations, and protections. However, I identified one transparency issue.

Typically, brokers state that a clientâs funds are held in separate bank accounts from those used for the companyâs corporate capital, which is done in order to shield the client from the companyâs credit liabilities. However, I couldnât find any mention of fund segregation in Headwayâs documents.

Despite this major omission, I should underline that the broker does indeed keep its clientsâ funds separate. I know this because Headway would not have obtained a license from the FSCA otherwise.

The other transparency issue I identified was the lack of a live spreads feed on the website, which would allow casual visitors to evaluate a brokerâs fee competitiveness and transparency.

Instead of a live spreads feed, Headway displays the âMinimal spreadâ rates for each instrument, which gives you a crude and less precise understanding of the pricing mechanism.

Is Headway Safe?

Despite some transparency issues, I concluded that Headway is reasonably safe to trade with due to the following factors:

  • It is authorized by the FSCA.
  • Keeps client funds in segregated accounts.
  • Guarantees negative balance protection.
  • Has easily accessible legal documents.

Fees

I found that Headwayâs Standard account offers super-competitive conditions for trading forex, stocks, and Bitcoin. However, the brokerâs commodity and index spreads were considerably higher than the benchmark. The Pro account is more cost-effective, but still lags behind other brokersâ raw-spread accounts. Still, Headway balances this with low-to-average swap fees and no inactivity fee. Deposits and withdrawals are also free.

Headway Swaps

A swap fee is the cost of keeping a trade open overnight, and itâs tied to the difference in interest rates between the two currencies in a pair. If youâre holding a buy (long) position, you may either pay or earn interest depending on the ratesâthis is called a swap long. The same applies to a sell (short) position, where the overnight charge or credit is called a swap short.

Headway offers the MetaTrader 4 and MetaTrader 5 platforms for desktop, web, and mobile trading. Both platforms feature fast order execution, copy trading, and automated trading via Expert Advisors (EAs). Headway has developed its own mobile app and offers a proprietary copy trading service from the client area. MetaTrader 5 Desktop

Straightforward design. MetaTrader stands out for its simple layout. In fact, it pretty much set the benchmark for how a trading platform must be designed, given that so many newer trading stations have replicated MTâs layout.

Easily Customized. One of the greatest perks of MetaTrader is its adaptability. The platform accommodates different trading styles and serves users with different experience levels. Moreover, MT5 is packed with multiple tutorials to help you make the most of it.

Algo Trading Capabilities. For more experienced traders, MT5 offers a Depth of Market (DOM) tool and Expert Advisors (EAs) for algorithmic trading. The platform also features a strategy tester tool, helping algo traders perfect their systems.

Clunky Charts. On the downside, MT5âs chart visuals feel outdated and somewhat unpolished. They are clearly outmatched by the more modern and refined interfaces of platforms like cTrader and TradingView.

Availability & Features

The MT5 platform by Headway is available for Windows and Mac users and supports 39 languages, including English, Spanish, German, Arabic, and Chinese.

MT5 features include:

  • Price Alerts: Set alerts when an instrument hits a specific price â ideal for spotting trade entry opportunities.
  • Customizable Watchlists: Keep tabs on your favorite instruments with ease.
  • One-Click Trading: Enter trades instantly at market price â perfect for scalpers or fast-paced traders.
  • Chart Trading: Place and manage orders directly from the chart, including entry points, volume, stop-loss, and take-profit levels.

Charting & Analysis Tools

MT5 is loaded with analytical tools, including:

  • 38 built-in technical indicators: From trend-following to oscillators and volume-based tools. You can use these to spot price trends and ranges and to assess their strength.
  • 24 drawing tools: Including Fibonacci retracements, Elliott Waves, and more for technical pattern spotting. I use tools like Fibonacci retracement levels to identify major support and resistance levels within a price trend. I then use these as reference points for possible rebounds/reversals or breakouts/breakdowns, depending on the underlying trend.
  • 21 timeframes: Great for multi-timeframe analysis â one of the largest offerings in the industry. Typically, I use higher timeframes (above 4H) to determine the marketâs general direction and smaller timeframes (below 1H) to spot viable entries within the broader trend.
  • 3 chart types: Line, bar, and candlestick options let traders view price action in their preferred format. Personally, I prefer candlesticks because they provide a more comprehensive picture. For example, a bullish Marubozu candlestick may signify strong buying sentiment, whereas the formation of a shooting star candlestick may indicate a possible bearish reversal.

That said, MT5âs charts get cluttered quite easily, especially when applying more than one technical indicator or drawing tool. Price action becomes obscured and difficult to interpret. Overall, MT5âs charts are not ideal for traders accustomed to streamlined and easily scalable setups.

Order Types

MT5 offers three execution modes and covers all the core order types needed by most traders:

  • Market Orders: Instant execution at the best available price â ideal for quick entries
  • Limit Orders: Target a specific price level for entry, though execution isnât guaranteed.
  • Stop Orders: Protect open positions with predefined risk levels. Stop-loss orders automatically convert into market orders once triggered.

MT5 App

The MT5 mobile app is available on iOS and Android devices and offers most of the functionalities of the desktop version. This makes the MT5 app a convenient tool for staying connected to the market and adjusting your positions on the fly.

You can place market, limit, and stop orders, as well as manage position size and risk directly from the app. That said, the charting experience still feels a bit cramped, and price action can be hard to scale and analyze comfortably on a small screen.

Headway Copy Trading

Headway provides copy trading from the client area. If you are a signal follower, you can scan all available strategies and assess their performance based on net gain, running losses, win rate, trades executed, and more. Signal providers can market their strategies from the âInvestor Areaâ, where they can set a preferred subscription fee. The broker itself does not charge a servicing fee for copy trading.

Headway Execution Model

Headway operates on a hybrid STP/ECN model without a dealing desk. Client orders are either filled at the best available price from the brokerâs pool of liquidity providers or they are matched electronically (buying-to-selling and selling-to-buying orders) via electronic communication networks.

I also noticed that Headway uses 5 separate servers, which are based in the UK (two), Germany, the US, and Indonesia. This gives you great latitude, allowing you to choose the fastest server based on your location.

For instance, I am based in Europe, and the system automatically connected me to the German server. With it, I recorded a 58.2 mscs ping, which almost matched the industry average of 60 milliseconds. Hence, I concluded that Headway will attract those who seek speedy order executions. However, keep in mind that your execution speed may differ depending on your location, internet speed, and other external factors.
Tradable Instruments

Headway offers more than 400 tradable instruments. It outperforms other brokers in the number of indices and cryptocurrencies it offers, but its stock offering could be greater. Its forex and commodity selections meet the industry average. Headway also stands out with its 10 synthetic assets and rare indices, such as the Jakarta Stock Exchange index. Overall, the offering is pretty diverse and suitable for many strategies.

Account Types and Terms

Headway has two retail accounts: Standard (spread-based with no commissions) and Pro (raw spreads plus a $3 round-turn commission). You can get started with as little as $10 and choose from several base currencies. The account creation process is fast and easy, and I completed it in less than 10 minutes. Headway also offers a Cent account that allows beginners and algo traders to test their systems in a real-world trading environment.

How to Open an Account With Headway

To open an account with Headway, I followed these simple steps:

  1. I clicked âGet Startedâ from the main page.
  2. I chose to sign up using my email.
  3. I provided my name and email address.
  4. I entered an account password.
  5. I confirmed my email address.
  6. I provided the rest of my personal info.
  7. I uploaded proof of ID and proof of address.

The Standard account keeps things simple: just a $10 minimum deposit, floating spreads, and zero commissions. Itâs a solid pick for casual traders who want straightforward pricing and a low barrier to entry.

The Pro account comes with tighter spreads and a $3 round-turn commission per lot. With a $100 minimum deposit, itâs still accessible, but better suited to more active and experienced traders.

Both accounts operate with a 30% margin call and a 0% stop-out level. Thatâs quite different from many brokers, which often set margin calls around 100% and stop-outs near 50%. A lower margin call alerts you earlier when your free margin is running thin, but a 0% stop-out means positions may stay open longer, increasing the risk of deeper drawdowns if the market moves sharply against you.

Headway also offers a Cent account, a great option for beginners who want to experience real-world trading without risking too much. Since its contract size is reduced to 10,000 units (down from the standard 100,000), your profits and losses will also be 10 times smaller than normal. This makes the Cent account also a great fit for algo traders, as they can use it to test their algorithmsâ performance and tweak their parameters accordingly.

Demo Accounts

Headway offers demo accounts on MT4 and MT5 that let traders explore the platforms and test their strategies in a risk-free environment. Since markets are constantly changing, itâs crucial to keep your skills sharp without risking real money. You can open a demo account before or alongside your live CFD account.

Swap-Free (Islamic) Accounts

Headway offers an Islamic account for swap-free trading. For further information, please contact Headwayâs customer support.

What Leverage Does Headway Offer?

Headway distinguishes itself by offering extremely lax leverage restrictions. You can apply unlimited leverage on your account, provided that you have traded at least 5 standard lots. Otherwise, Headwayâs standard maximum leverage is 1:1000, which is still considered pretty high. For accounts with a balance below $5,000, Headway offers a maximum leverage of up to 1:2000.

Trading on margin with high leverage is extremely risky and may result in significant losses.

Research

Headway offers a basic economic calendar and publishes daily market briefs that help you track the most significant financial market developments. I liked this type of content for its straightforward and easily digestible format. However, Headwayâs research offering lacks diversity. There are no video breakdowns, actionable trading signals, or any third-party content.

The Headwayâs economic calendar informs traders of upcoming economic releases and financial news that could move the market and create viable trading opportunities.

The market insights are available from the âForex newsâ segment of the website, under the âLearnâ category. These help you stay in sync with the latest market-moving headlines and understand what, how, and why is driving the market.

For example, you can read about the Bank of England (BoE)âs latest monetary policy decision and how it is expected to influence the value of the cable (GBPUSD), or the impact of the latest inflation report in the U.S. on the value of the dollar.
Education

Headway provides hundreds of educational articles and videos, as well as a comprehensive educational course covering technical and fundamental analysis and pattern recognition. Overall, I consider Headwayâs education a good resource for learning for beginner and intermediate traders.

Headway has published over 180 articles covering various trading topics, from reading the economic calendar to assessing trading risk. You can find these materials under the âEducationâ subcategory of the âLearnâ tab.

I especially liked the more unconventional articles, such as âCase Study: A Failed Trade in XAUUSD (December 2025)â. While most brokers focus on profit generation, with clickbait articles claiming to unveil the quickest path to forex riches, Headway is not afraid to acknowledge the more painful side of trading. What is more, Headway is one of the few brokers brave enough to show you how to learn from your mistakes â a crucial skill that will help you go a long way as a trader.

You can supplement your learning with Headwayâs forex course for beginners, which covers matters related to technical and fundamental analysis and trading psychology. The course contains 5 quizzes so that you can test what youâve learned after each lesson.

The Bottom Line

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in South Africa, Headway is a financial derivatives broker offering more than 400 assets across various markets. It is licensed and regulated by the FSCA, keeps client funds segregated, and guarantees negative balance protection.

Headway distinguishes itself with its crypto-friendly offering. It charges razor-sharp spreads and swaps on BTCUSD with Headwayâs Standard account and supports free crypto payments.

I also recorded favorable conditions for trading forex pairs and stocks, though the brokerâs indices and commodity costs were quite elevated.

Headway offers the MT4 and MT5 platforms, as well as its own mobile app and copy trading service. It also provides comprehensive educational content, unrestricted leverage, and enhanced copy trading services. However, its customer support appeared unreliable during my test.

In conclusion, I find Headway to be a great choice for crypto traders, high-leverage traders, and traders interested in copy trading.

Understanding the Regulatory Protections of Your Account

Brokers operate multiple entities globally, but regulatory protections vary. Some regulators enforce stricter financial standards than others, so traders should understand the safety measures of the entity with which they choose to open an account.

Here is what you need to be looking for in a broker in terms of safety mechanisms:

  • Segregation of Client Funds: Keeping client funds in segregated bank accounts from the ones used for the brokerâs corporate capital negates the risk of accounting errors. All HYCM entities guarantee the segregation of client funds from the companyâs corporate capital.
  • Negative Balance Protection: This safety mechanism removes the risk of trading losses exceeding the account balance. In other words, the losses you incur from trading are capped at the amount you have put in your trading account. All HYCM entities guarantee negative balance protection.
  • Compensation Scheme: A compensation scheme protects traders against the brokerâs liabilities if the company becomes insolvent. Clients of HYCM Capital Markets (UK) Limited are protected by up to GBP 85,000 under the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS).
  • Maximum Leverage: Capping the maximum leverage restricts the extent of market exposure to retail traders. The higher the leverage, the higher the potential profits and potential losses. The maximum retail leverage with HYCM is 1:500.

Stability and Transparency

In our Trust category assessments, we evaluate factors tied to stability and transparency, including the brokerâs longevity, company size, and information transparency.

Founded in 1977, HYCMâs long history speaks to its established presence and reliability in the market. According to its LinkedIn page, the broker employs over 100 professionals, further highlighting its operational scale and overall stability as a trusted industry player.

I reviewed HYCMâs legal documents and client agreement and found everything in order. All relevant information is readily available and easy to discern. I did not discover any transparency issues.

  • Stop Orders: They are used to support open positions by limiting the maximum loss that can be incurred if the market turns in the opposite direction. A stop-loss order is placed at a fixed price below or above the spot price. If the market does indeed turn and triggers the stop-loss, it will transform into a market order and get filled at the best possible price.

What Are CFDs?

Contracts for difference (CFDs) are derivatives that speculate on the underlying assetâs price without physical ownership.

For example, a long position on gold would generate profit as the price rises or incur a loss as it falls, all without the need to purchase actual gold bars.

One of the biggest advantages of trading CFDs is that traders can get in and out of the market almost instantaneously, thereby catching even minute changes in the price of the derivative.

First-time traders can also refer to HYCMâs blog with over 20 articles that cover basic trading topics, such as âWhat is leverage in forex tradingâ or âWhat is a pip in forex tradingâ.

The Bottom Line

Founded in 1977 and headquartered in London, HYCM is a well-established broker offering over 1,250 tradable and investment products. It is regulated by the FCA in the UK and the DFSA in the UAE, and is also incorporated in St. Vincent and the Grenadines.

The brokerâs standout strength lies in its focus on the needs of swing and position tradersâhighlighted by low swap rates and comprehensive market research, particularly its insights into seasonal price patterns.

On the downside, spreads could be more competitive, and copy trading is not supported, which may be a drawback for some traders.

Overall, I consider HYCM a solid choice for first-time traders and swing or position traders of all experience levels, thanks to its long-standing reputation, low swaps, and strong research tools.

MetaTrader 5 features three types of order execution: market, pending, and one-click trading, which supports immediate entries at the spot price.

  • Stop Orders: They are used to support open positions by limiting the maximum loss that can be incurred if the market turns in the opposite direction. A stop-loss order is placed at a fixed price below or above the spot price. If the market does indeed turn and triggers the stop-loss, it will transform into a market order and get filled at the best possible price.

Understanding the Regulatory Protections of Your Account

Brokers operate multiple entities to serve clients globally, yet regulatory protections vary by jurisdiction. Some regulators enforce strict financial standards, while others are more lenient. Traders should understand the protection offered by the entity where they intend to open an account.

  • Segregation of client funds. Keeping client funds in segregated bank accounts from the ones used for the brokerâs corporate capital negates the risk of accounting errors. All of IGâs entities ensure this.
  • Negative balance protection. This safety mechanism removes the risk of trading losses exceeding the account balance. In other words, the losses you incur from trading are capped at the amount you have put in your trading account. This is especially important in volatile markets. The UK and EU entities provide negative balance protection.
  • Compensation scheme. A compensation scheme protects retail traders against the brokerâs liabilities in the unlikely event that the company becomes insolvent. Clients of IG Markets Ltd are insured by FSCS for up to Â£85,000.
  • Maximum leverage. Capping the maximum leverage restricts the extent of market exposure to retail traders. The higher the leverage, the higher the potential profits and potential losses. IGâs entity with the highest leverage, 1:200, is the offshore IG International Limited.

Stability and Transparency

In our tests for the Trust category, we also cover factors relating to stability and transparency. Here, we focus on the brokerâs operating history, size, and overall transparency.

IG traces its origins to 1974, marking it as one of the oldest and most experienced forex brokers. According to its LinkedIn page, the company is headquartered in London and has 1,001-5,000 employees.

In my research, IG showed high transparency in its regulatory status, listing its regulator in the footer of each page of the ig.com/uk website. The website breaks down fees clearly on the Costs and Charges page. Traders can find the Customer Agreement on the Terms and Agreements page.

Is IG Safe to Trade With?

To summarize, my findings indicate that IG can be regarded as having a high level of trust and stability due to the following qualities:

  • Regulated by multiple top-tier regulators
  • 50 years of operating history
  • Publicly traded company valued at over Â£3.5 billion
  • High level of transparency

Fees

My hands-on tests showed that IG offers competitive trading fees overall. Spreads in major pairs are among the tightest in the industry, but other instruments are closer to the industry average. Swap fees were average. IG does not charge any inactivity fee or fees for deposits and withdrawals.

Are IG Fees Competitive?

I rate the fees at IG as competitive overall for the following reasons:

Platform and Tools

IG offers its proprietary platform available on the web and mobile. I rated both versions as among the best in the industry, with powerful features like sentiment data from IGâs large client base. Clients can also access four other CFD platforms: MetaTrader 4, TradingView, ProRealTime, and L2 Dealer.

IG Online Trading Platform

The award-winning IG Online Trading Platform is intuitive, highly customizable, and packs an impressive range of features, including watchlists, a news feed, alerts, one-click trading, trading from the chart, trading signals, and client sentiment data.
The IG Platform is web-based and accessible via your browser without any downloads. The interface is clean and simple, making it easy for new traders to get up and running.

Watchlists are an essential part of a traderâs toolkit, enabling you to group markets of your choice together in a single easy-to-find place. With watchlists thereâs no need to waste time searching for your favorite markets â you can stay on top of prices with just a glance.

The ability to customize and save workspaces was a great help to me in executing my strategies. I created unique workspaces for each asset class, such as forex, metals, and energies. By flipping through these via the tabs at the top left of the platform, I was able to scan the charts of multiple markets in a short time to find trading opportunities.

The IG Online Platform has a built-in news feed from Thomson Reuters, which publishes a steady stream of stories throughout the day. The feed includes updates on major economic releases and central bank policy. The News and Analysis section also covers technical analysis, key support and resistance levels, and trade ideas.

IG provides client sentiment data drawing from its user base of over 300,000 clients. Sentiment data shows the percentage of traders that are long or short in a currency pair. This gives you powerful insight into the psychology of a market. Traders can interpret the data in a variety of ways. Most commonly, it is understood that when an extreme percentage of traders are either long or short an instrument, a trend reversal may be coming.

Charting within the IG Online Platform is robust, with a better-than-average range of indicators, drawing tools, time frames, and chart types. Traders can make use of the following range of charting features:

  • 33 Indicators
  • 17 Time frames
  • 19 Drawing Tools
  • 5 Chart Types

The IG Online Platform provides flexibility with a strong range of available order types:

  • Market order
  • Limit order
  • Stop loss
  • Trailing stop
  • Guaranteed stop loss (UK only)

Time-in-force conditions can be applied to pending orders. You can specify the duration for which your open order remains active by marking it as âGood Till Canceledâ (GTC) or setting it to expire on a future date of your choice.

The IG Online Platform has a sophisticated range of alerts to help optimize your trading performance. You can set up alerts to inform you about price movements, news events, and even emerging technical patterns.

  • Price level alerts are triggered when your market hits the price you set.
  • Price change alerts trigger when a market moves your chosen amount. These can be set in pips or percentage terms.
  • Technical indicator alerts tell you when a market meets your technical conditions. For example, you can receive an alert when RSI crosses the 70 level into overbought conditions.
  • Economic calendar alerts remind you of key economic releases.

The platform also provides trading signals from third-party Autochartist and PIA First, showing a bullish or bearish bias for various instruments in a short-term and intraday time frame.

Trade Analytics Tool

The IG Trade Analytics Tool, accessible via the My IG client portal, provides valuable insights into your trading strengths and weaknesses. The tool shows a transparent summary of the total returns from your closed positions, including all fees and adjustments. Key metrics like return rate, win rate, and profit/loss ratio enable you to analyze your trading history. When reviewing your performance, the platform allows you the flexibility of setting custom time periods. In my view, this is an excellent tool for tracking your progress and fine-tuning your approach.

IG Online Trading Platform: My Key Takeaways

While trading on the IG Online Platform, I appreciated the ability to customize it to my preferences and create multiple workspaces. This makes it easy to stay on top of what is going on in various markets and lots of timeframes. Charting is robust, and the range of order types provides traders with advanced flexibility.

The interface strikes a perfect balance between being clean and uncluttered while still offering advanced features. Its impressive suite of tools includes Autochartist, client sentiment analysis, the Thomson Reuters news feed, and built-in trade analytics. The only drawback I found was a lack of micro-lot trading â this feature would be a great improvement, especially for beginners looking to manage risk with smaller trade sizes.

IG Trading App

The IG mobile app is available for Android and iOS. It incorporates the key features of the web platform, like watchlists, advanced order types, alerts, trading from the chart, client sentiment, Autochartist signals, screeners, and the Thomson Reuters news feed.

As with the web platform, you can easily switch between demo and live trading accounts. Two-factor authentication is available for an added layer of security. You can also deposit and withdraw funds via the mobile app.

Advanced charting is available within the app, sufficient to do in-depth technical analysis of the markets while on the move. Traders can work with:

  • 33 indicators
  • 5 Chart types
  • 19 drawing tools
  • 17 time frames

The IG mobile app doesnât skimp on order types eitherâtraders can use standard and advanced order types:

  • Market
  • Limit
  • Stop loss
  • Trailing stop

Time in force conditions, like Good-Till-Canceled (GTC), can be applied to pending orders.

IG Trading App: My Key Takeaways

I found the IG Trading App intuitive and beginner-friendly while offering a powerful range of features. You can monitor your market positions, place trades, and stay updated with the latest market news and analysis. This well-designed app can accommodate most trading functions while you are on the move. I rate it as well above average for the industry.

MetaTrader 4 Desktop

IG offers MetaTrader 4 for desktops, which includes advanced functions such as automated trading.

MetaTrader 4 is available in 39 languages, from Arabic to Vietnamese. The platform provides popular features, including the following:

  • Alerts: This feature updates traders when an instrument reaches a specific price level.
  • Watchlists: Traders can create a list of their favorite instruments and follow live quotes in a market watch panel.
  • One-Click Trading: This feature allows traders to execute orders with a single click and no secondary confirmation. This feature enables traders to operate faster and is especially useful for short-term traders.
  • Trading from the Chart: MT4 also allows users the convenience of trading directly from the chart.

MetaTrader also delivers when it comes to the range of available order types. The platform offers these order types:

  • Market Order: Traders use market orders to buy or sell an instrument at the best current price.
  • Limit Order: Traders use limit orders to buy or sell an instrument at a specified price or better.
  • Stop Loss Order: Traders use stop-loss orders to buy or sell an instrument when its price reaches a specified level.
  • Trailing Stop Order: Traders use trailing stop-loss orders as a stop-loss order at a defined percentage or dollar amount away from an instrumentâs current market price. This order type allows traders to secure profits when they are in a winning trade while not having to exit the position.

MT4 charting features are robust and include:

  • 30 Technical Indicators: These include classic trend indicators, volume indicators, and oscillators.
  • 23 Analytical Objects: These include lines, channels, Gann, and Fibonacci tools.
  • 9 Time Frames: Traders can choose from nine time frames, from one minute to one month.
  • 3 Chart Types: Traders can use Bar Charts, Japanese Candlestick Charts, and Line Charts.

MetaTrader is also popular due to its automated trading features, allowing users to develop, test, and apply Expert Advisors (EAs). EAs are programs that monitor and trade markets using algorithms. While being the most feature-rich and popular trading platform, MetaTrader 4 does not have a slick interface and requires some time and effort to learn.

MetaTrader 4 Mobile App

IG offers the MetaTrader 4 app for mobile trading, which is available for Android and iOS. The app offers popular features such as alerts, 1-click trading, and trading from the chart.

The MT4 app also provides standard order types, including pending and stop orders. However, trailing stop-loss orders are only available from the desktop.

To change the language of the MT4 app, you must change the language for your entire phone.

As with the desktop and web platforms, the interface is not highly intuitive, but the MT4 app offers an above-average range of features.

MetaTrader 4: My Key Takeaways

As one of the most popular trading platforms in the world and the only one offered by many forex brokers, I have spent a lot of time testing MT4. The look and feel of the platform are a bit dated, and I feel there is room for improvement in design and usability.

Still, MT4 is a highly versatile platform that outperforms many competitors, offering advanced charting, a comprehensive range of order types, and popular features such as one-click trading, trading directly from charts, and customizable alerts. Its desktop platform stands out with advanced capabilities, including the ability to run and backtest automated strategies, making it a powerful tool for skilled traders. However, its steep learning curve means it is better suited for experienced traders rather than beginners.

One drawback is that MT4 does not offer the full range of tradable instruments.

TradingView

IG recently joined TradingViewâs Broker Integration Platform, enabling its clients to trade directly from the TradingView platform (either via the TradingView.com website or the desktop app).

Key features include cutting-edge, highly customizable charts with over 100 popular indicators and 50 drawing tools and a community of millions of like-minded traders and investors.

The platform also features powerful tools like screeners for both shares and forex pairs, heatmaps, cloud-based trading alerts, and news feeds with stories from Reuters and Dow Jones.

ProRealTime

Live account holders at IG also have access to ProRealTime â a third-party platform geared towards experienced chart traders, order book traders and scalpers. It features various advanced features:

  • Robust charts with 100+ technical indicators, tools, and price comparisons.
  • Scalping order book with an interface designed for speed.
  • Advanced order types, including triple orders, OCO orders, and trailing stops.
  • Automated trading, backtesting, and optimization.
  • Market playback tool.
  • Access to over 17,000 tradable instruments.
  • Advanced options trading functionality.

The platform was designed to make algo trading as accessible as possible, via ProBuilder, its easy-to-use coding language. Algorithms built in ProRealTime can fully automate your trading and can execute your trades according to different criteria like historical price action and readings from technical indicators.

As a retail IG client, you get ProRealTime charts for free for your first month, while professional clients get free access for three months. After that, ProRealTime continues to be free as long as you make four trades in the same month. If not, you will be charged a Â£30 monthly fee.

L2 Dealer

L2 Dealer is IGâs direct market access (DMA) platform, suitable for advanced and professional traders. L2 Dealer enables clients to trade share or forex CFDs or deal shares outright, directly through the order books of international exchanges. Advantages of the L2 Dealer platform include:

  • DMA and OTC access to over 17,000 tradeable markets globally.
  • Wide range of native, synthetic, and algorithmic order types.
  • Integrated market alerts, news feeds, and market commentary.
  • Volume metrics to assess an underlying marketâs liquidity.

IG Order Execution Model

IG acts as principal and not as agent and is the sole venue for the execution of trades. This means that IG acts as a market maker. Clients trade with IG and not within the underlying market.

Tradable Instruments

IG stands out as a frontrunner in the area of tradable instruments. It boasts an impressive portfolio of over 17,000 CFDs covering forex, commodities, indices, shares, bonds, and cryptocurrencies. There are also CFDs on futures, options, and spot markets. Additionally, IG has recently added US-listed futures and options via tastytrade.

What are CFDs?

A Contract for Difference (CFD) is an agreement between a buyer and a seller to exchange the difference between the opening price and the closing price of a trade. If the price rises, the seller pays the buyer the difference. If the price falls, the buyer pays the seller the difference.

IG Instruments: My Key Takeaways

I was very impressed by the range of tradable instruments at IG. In addition to an above-average range of currency pairs, indices, commodities, bonds, and shares, I noted the availability of CFDs on futures and options, which are less commonly available.

Customer Support

IG provides support 24/7, except for a short break from 10 p.m. Friday to 8 a.m. Saturday, on the telephone, WhatsApp, and live chat. In light of its fast and helpful responses across dozens of tests, I rated IGâs support as better than average for the industry.

IG Customer Support Test

I tested IG customer service over two weeks with dozens of queries, ranging from platforms to fees and account-related issues. I noted that IG support staff were usually well-informed and courteous.

Live chat and WhatsApp support were impressively quick, often responding within seconds, while emails were typically addressed the same day or within one business day.

Phone support was equally efficient, with rapid responses, and I appreciated not having to navigate automated questions before reaching an operator. Support via the phone was especially helpful in guiding me through the setup of the L2 Dealer Platform.

Deposit and Withdrawal

IG clients can deposit and withdraw funds via bank wire transfer, credit/debit cards, and PayPal. Processing times are relatively fast for the industry. Deposits and withdrawals are both free of charge.

Account Types and Terms

IG offers four accounts: CFD, Spread Betting, Share Dealing, and Smart Portfolio. The account opening process is fully digital and can be completed via the website in 10 minutes. For CFD trading and Spread Betting, traders can access free demo accounts via the IG Platform and MetaTrader 4.

IG offers demo accounts for the IG Web Platform and MetaTrader 4. Demo accounts are especially important for beginners as they allow them to practice their strategies and get comfortable with the trading platform without risking real money.

The demo account features live quotes and simulates live market conditions in assets like forex and CFDs on commodities, indices, and stocks. Once users are up to speed on a demo, they can easily switch to a live account.

Professional Account

Experienced traders can open an IG professional account, which allows for access to greater leverage and trading in CFDs on cryptocurrencies. To qualify for a professional account, traders must meet at least two of the following criteria:

  • To trade leveraged derivatives in significant sizes over the last four quarters.
  • To have a financial instrument portfolio exceeding â¬500k.
  • To work in the financial sector in a professional position requiring knowledge of derivatives trading for at least a year.

Islamic Account

What is CFD Leverage?

One of the reasons that traders are attracted to the forex and CFD markets is the high degree of available leverage. Leverage is the use of borrowed funds to increase the size of your trading positions beyond what would be possible using only the cash in your account.

The maximum leverage allowed by UK FCA for retail clients is 1:30. This means that with an account of $1,000, you can control up to $30,000 worth of positions in the market. Leverage is often described as a âdouble-edged swordâ as it can hurt you as much as it helps you. Traders must remember that it can amplify both their profits and their losses.

Available leverage differs according to the asset class, with the most available for CFDs on forex and the least for CFDs on crypto. The figures below are for IGâs FCA-regulated UK entity (IG Markets Ltd).

Research

IG shines in the research category with a wealth of high-quality resources to draw from. The broker regularly publishes updated technical and fundamental research materials in written and video format. The content is insightful and reflects IGâs remarkable depth of experience. Within the IG Online Platform, traders can get news updates and trade ideas from the Thomson Reuters news feed. Trading signals from Autochartist are also available within the trading platform.

The News and Trade Ideas section features themed articles like previews of the coming week, which help orient traders on what to expect from the highest-impact news releases. In-depth coverage of major currencies like the euro and the US dollar covers important technical price levels and market-moving economic data.

The market analysis section on the IG website includes high-quality and detailed market forecasts, recaps, and coverage of major fundamental data and technical levels to watch.

Stock Screener

The TipRanks stock screener lets you find shares suited to your trading strategy. You can filter by sector, price target upside, dividend yield, and more to find investments matching your preferred criteria.

Live Market Commentary

âTrade Live with IGâ is a daily show designed to kickstart your trading day with valuable insights and market analysis. Each session includes:

  • Real-time analysis of overnight news, company results, and analyst updates.
  • Live Q&A and community interaction for an engaging trading experience.
  • Key topics coverage, including stock analysis, market trends, trading strategies, and financial news.

You can participate by commenting during the stream or emailing your questions to ask@ig.com.

âTrade Live with IGâ seamlessly blends expert analysis with entertainment, offering fresh takes on technical analysis and macroeconomic developments to keep you informed and inspired.

Email Updates

IG offers two email newsletters. âThe Morning Callâ updates you with top stories in the markets, the biggest risers and fallers, broker ratings, and the economic releases for the day and which markets they impact. While âThe Trade of the Weekâ walks you through a highlighted trade and the market analysis and data driving the opportunity. The second newsletter can also be viewed within the IG Online Platform.

IG Research: My Key Takeaways

IG offers a powerful mix of in-house and third-party research. I like that the materials not only contain news and analysis but also feature specific trade ideas. The in-house research and Autochartist signals are accessible to beginners. Experienced traders can benefit from the pro-grade analysis within the Thomson Reuters feed. I rate IG as an industry leader in the area of research.

Education

IG offers a wealth of educational resources covering essential basics along with in-depth courses and live sessions via the IG Academy. The courses cater to various trader levels, composed of concise, easy-to-digest lessons, each concluding with a quiz to reinforce learning. I judged the content to be high-quality and helpful in establishing a foundation of market knowledge.

The IG Academy features 19 courses by different trader levels. Beginner-level courses tackle topics like orders, execution, and leverage. Intermediate-level courses introduce key themes like technical and fundamental analysis. Meanwhile, experienced traders can benefit from advanced level courses containing content like trading options with CFDs.

The broker also conducts regular webinars. During live sessions, trading experts share their knowledge and insights across a wide range of topics. An archive of previous webinars is available on the IG website, covering practical themes like platform tutorials.

IG also offers a wide range of educational articles and videos covering topics like economic indicators, central banks, trading strategies, and risk management. This content is insightful and reflects the depth of IGâs experience.

The Bottom Line

With 50 years of experience, IG has grown into a brokerage powerhouse serving over 346,000 clients worldwide. Scores ranged from better-than-average to exceptional in most categories of our review, reflecting a very well-rounded broker.

Licensed by multiple top-tier regulators, a publicly traded company, and highly transparent, IG excels in trust and stability. Spreads in CFDs on forex majors and indices are highly competitive, but most other instruments are closer to the industry average.

The range of platforms is excellent and can cater to all levels of traders â from beginners and casual traders to seasoned professionals. I especially liked the innovative tools like client sentiment and the in-depth trade analyzer.

Education and research materials are superb, with interactive courses and live video analysis from industry experts. Another bonus is that since my last review, customer support hours have been expanded to nearly 24/7.

IG could improve by offering more competitive commissions on CFDs on shares, improving the spreads in commodities, adding micro-lot trading to the IG Online Platform, and expanding the range of tradable instruments on MT4.

Overall, IG provides a service that is very hard to beat. If you are looking for a broker who can both nurture trader development and meet the needs of experienced professionals, I highly recommend IG.

This review covers the UK entity of IG. If you are a US citizen, please visit the tastyfx review for relevant information.

Our Take on IG

Founded in 1974, IG Group (originally called IG Index) is a forex and CFD industry pioneer. With a strong international presence, IG entities are licensed by multiple regulators, including top-tier FCA, FINMA, BaFin, and ASIC.

The London-based financial giant provides the proprietary IG Online Trading Platform and mobile app along with MetaTrader 4, TradingView, L2 Dealer, and ProRealTime. IG is distinguished by its massive range of tradable assets including over 17,000 CFDs on spot markets, futures, and options. Clients can also access over 13,000 real shares from US, UK, and international exchanges. The $1 billion acquisition of tastytrade in 2021 has enabled IG to further broaden by offering pure-form US-listed options and futures.

Spreads in forex majors are highly competitive, while the majority of other assets I tested are closer to the industry average. The depth and scope of education and research materials are exceptional. Clients can also benefit from valuable resources like sentiment data, Autochartist signals, and the Trade Analyzer tool. With fast order execution, tight spreads, and 1-click trading, IG is well suited to day traders and scalpers.

Recommended in 6 best broker guides: 
Forex | Share CFD | Spread Betting | Regulated Brokers | Scalping | Gold

IG Pros and Cons

Pros Cons
  • Over 50 years of experience
  • FX spreads as low as 0.6 pips
  • Fast, reliable execution (average of 0.014 seconds)
  • Diverse, feature-rich platforms
  • Trade analytics tool
  • Industry-leading research
  • DMA Access via L2 Dealer
  • VPS hosting
  • First-class educational resources
  • No fees for deposits, withdrawals, or account inactivity
  • High commissions on CFDs on shares
  • Lacks MT5 platform
  • Limited tradable instruments via MT4
  • Islamic account only available at the Dubai entity

Who is IG For?

When reviewing a broker, we assess its suitability for implementing various trading strategies. To achieve this, we evaluate the availability of features and tools necessary for executing specific strategies. Here is our verdict for IG:

What Sets IG Apart?

IG stands head and shoulders above the competition in multiple categories. Its Standard account offers rock-bottom trading costs, with spreads as low as 0.6 pips in pairs like EUR/USD and 1.4 pips in the DAX 40. The depth of instruments in each asset class is also outstanding, and IG offers CFDs on the spot market, futures market, and even options.

IG Video Review

In this review of IG, we focused on the UK entity (IG Markets Ltd), which is regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA). We conducted our tests using a CFD account via the IG Online Platform. Some features and services may vary depending on where you reside.

tastyfx has earned a strong trust ranking from FXEmpire due to its regulation by the NFA and CFTC, along with its financial stability and transparency. Its parent company, IG Group, is publicly traded on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: IGG) and is a member of the FTSE 250. I rate tastyfx as among the most trustworthy and stable brokers in the forex industry.

tastyfx Regulators

In our reviews, we examine the regulatory status of each entity operated by a broker. This allows us to compare the different levels of client protection. We rank regulators using a three-tier system, where Tier-1 licensing reflects the highest level of regulation.

Here are my findings on tastyfx:

  • TASTYFX, LLC (âtastyfxâ) is a registeredâ¯Retail Foreign Exchange Dealer (RFED) with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and is a Member of the National Futures Association (NFA ID 509630). We rate CFTC and NFA as Tier-1 regulators.

chunked.content:
Client Protection

Investor protections depend heavily on the regulator, and under U.S. rules, TASTYFX LLC offers safeguards that are more robust than those offered by most global forex brokers.

tastyfx does not segregate client funds and does not provide negative balance protection as many global and European brokers do. tastyfx does not segregate client funds and does not offer negative balance protection, unlike many global and European brokers. This is largely because U.S. regulations do not allow retail forex accounts to be held in segregated trust accounts. If the firm were to become insolvent, client funds would be treated as unsecured claims, meaning creditors would be paid first, and customers would recover funds only if assets remained.

At the same time, tastyfx operates under the stringent oversight of the National Futures Association and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, two of the most demanding regulators in the world. Brokers must meet high capital requirements, file regular financial reports, and submit to ongoing audits. Both agencies also have strong enforcement powers, including public disciplinary actions, fines, and license suspensions, which adds a meaningful layer of security.

Stability and Transparency

When we evaluate trust, we look beyond regulation to signs of stability and transparency. That includes how long a company has been operating, its scale, and how clearly it explains its rules and costs.

tastyfx benefits from the 50+ year track record of its parent company, IG Group, one of the oldest names in online trading. tastyfx itself is headquartered in Chicago, while IG is based in London and employs thousands of employees globally.

During my 2-week evaluation period, transparency stood out. I could easily fins all regulatory information, and pricing details such as spreads and margin rates are clearly published. You can also access key documents, like the Customer Agreement, on the tastyfx website.

Is tastyfx Safe to Trade With?

In short, tastyfx earns a high trust and stability score thanks to the following:

  • Regulated by top-tier NFA and CFTC
  • Parent company IG has 50+ years of operating history
  • IG is a publicly traded company valued at over Â£4B
  • High level of transparency

Fees

My hands-on tests showed that tastyfx offers highly competitive trading-related fees. Spreads in major pairs are among the tightest in the industry, and swap fees are better than average. And high-volume clients can also earn substantial rebates, further lowering costs.

tastyfx Trading Fees

tastyfx Spreads

I tested the spreads at tastyfx across various markets during the London open and after the New York open. At these times, the market is typically highly liquid with the tightest spreads.

Spreads were tight on the major currency pairs, with EUR/USD and USD/JPY starting as low as 0.8 pips during peak hours and widening slightly later in the day.

Pairs like GBP/USD and AUD/USD remained steady around 1 pip, while less actively traded pairs such as GBP/JPY and NZD/USD showed wider spreads outside peak trading.

Overall, pricing stayed competitive, especially during high-liquidity sessions.

tastyfx Swap Fees

I have also tested tastyfx overnight fees on January 9, 2026. Known as swap rates, these fees are charged for holding long and short positions on a standard-sized forex contract. A standard contract represents 100,000 units of the base currency.

Instrument Swap Long Swap Short
EUR/USD Credit of $3.40 Charge of $7.60
GBP/JPY Charge of $21.40 Credit of $14.60

My tests showed that swap rates at tastyfx are better than average for the industry.

tastyfx Non-Trading Fees

tastyfx does not charge any non-trading costs, including inactivity or account maintenance fees.

tastyfx does not impose non-trading fees such as inactivity or account maintenance charges. In this area it again stands out to me as better than average.

Volume-Based Cash Rebates

tastyfx offers a volume-based rebate program aimed at active traders. Once you trade $1 million in notional volume within a calendar month, you can earn cashback on your trading costs, with rebates of up to 15 % of the spread or commission youâve paid. The program works across both spread-only and commission-based accounts, and rewards increase as trading volume rises.

Because forex is traded on leverage, reaching the $1 million threshold requires less capital than you might imagine. Rebates are calculated monthly and automatically credited the following month. In my view, this really adds to the appeal of tastyfx.

Are tastyfx Fees Competitive?

I rate the fees at tastyfx as highly competitive for the following reasons:

  • Very tight spreads in major pairs, as low as 0.6 pips in EUR/USD
  • The opportunity to earn rebates and further lower costs
  • Better-than-average swap fees

Platforms and Tools

tastyfx offers a strong lineup of trading platforms. Its own tastyfx web and mobile platforms rank among the best Iâve tested, with standout features like built-in sentiment data. On top of that, tastyfx supports MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, TradingView, and ProRealTime. Whether youâre a casual trader who looks for simple execution and clean design, or a more experienced trader preferring advanced charting and automated strategies, tastyfx has you covered.

Platform/Tool Suitable For
tastyfx Web Platform Traders who want a fast, uncluttered web-based experience with strong customization. Best for discretionary forex traders who rely on indicators, alerts, and trading signals.
tastyfx Mobile App Active traders who need full trading, charting, alerts, and account management on the go from a customizable mobile app.
MetaTrader 4/5 Experienced and algorithmic traders who use automated strategies, professional-grade indicators, and VPS hosting. Best for those who need ultra-fast execution and optimal uptime.
TradingView Technical traders who prioritize advanced charting, a wide range of indicators, and strategy testing using historical data.
ProRealTime Advanced technical traders who require flexible timeframes, deep chart-based analysis, custom indicator development, and seamless integration with the tastyfx trading platform.

tastyfx Web Platform

Key Features

The tastyfx web platform is easy to use and thoughtfully designed, with enough customization to satisfy active traders. Core features include watchlists, real-time news, alerts, one-click trading, chart-based order entry, and built-in trading signals.

Because it runs entirely in a browser, thereâs nothing to install, and the clean layout makes it easy for new users to get comfortable. I especially liked the way watchlists are designed. They let you track popular markets, recently traded instruments, or create custom lists tailored to your trading style.

Charts

Charting on the tastyfx platform is strong and flexible, offering 33 technical indicators, 19 drawing tools, 17 time frames, and five chart types. You can arrange multiple charts on a single screen or combine them with watchlists, news, and alerts to suit your workflow.

The platform also lets you create multiple workspaces and easily switch between them using tabs. I found this feature super useful and created a range of workspaces, including different groups of assets and features. In this way, you can set up unique workspaces to suit various trading strategies and access them fast.

Orders

The tastyfx platform supports all the order types most traders need, including market, limit, stop-loss, and trailing stop orders. You can also control how long orders remain active by setting them as good-til-canceled or choosing a specific expiration date.

Alerts

You can set simple price alerts to know when a market hits a specific level, or more nuanced alerts based on price changes measured in pips or percentages. For more technical traders, indicator alerts flag conditions such as RSI moving into overbought or oversold territory. There are also economic calendar alerts that notify you ahead of major data releases.

Sentiment Data

tastyfx provides client sentiment data drawing from the IG user base of over 300,000 clients. Sentiment data shows the percentage of traders that are long or short in a currency pair. This gives you powerful insight into the marketâs psychology. Traders can interpret the data in many ways. Most commonly, it is understood that when an extreme percentage of traders are either long or short an instrument, a trend reversal may be coming.

Thomson Reuters New Feed

The platform has a built-in news feed from Thomson Reuters. A steady stream of stories is published throughout the day. The feed includes concise updates on global news headlines, major economic releases, and central bank policy. It also covers technical analysis, key support and resistance levels, and trade ideas.

tastyfx Web Platform: My Key Takeaways

In my day-to-day use, the tastyfx platform struck a good balance between flexibility and simplicity. The ability to customize layouts and switch between multiple workspaces makes it easier to monitor different markets and time frames without feeling cluttered.

Charting is robust, order types are flexible, and built-in tools like Autochartist, client sentiment, and the Thomson Reuters news feed add real professional-grade value. The clean interface keeps things approachable for beginners, while the depth of features is enough to satisfy veteran traders.

tastyfx Mobile App

The tastyfx mobile app, available on iOS and Android, closely mirrors the web platform. It includes watchlists, advanced order types, alerts, chart-based trading, client sentiment data, Autochartist signals, and a Thomson Reuters news feed, making it easy to manage trades on the go without giving up core features.

As with the web platform, you can easily flip between demo and live trading accounts. Two-factor authentication is available for an added layer of security. It is also possible to add and withdraw funds via the mobile app.

Charts

Charting in the tastyfx mobile app is on par with the web platform, offering 33 technical indicators, 19 drawing tools, 17 time frames, and five chart types.

Orders

To help traders manage risk, the mobile app supports market and limit orders, along with stop losses.

tastyfx Mobile App: My Key Takeaways

The tastyfx mobile app felt intuitive and easy to navigate, without sacrificing functionality. It handles core tasks like monitoring positions, placing trades, and following market news and analysis smoothly, making it a reliable option for trading on the go. Overall, I rate it as much better than average.

tastyfx Order Execution Model

tastyfx uses market execution, sourcing prices from multiple venues and executing orders at the best current market price without requotes. The order management system will never fill client orders at a level worse than requested, though your order may be rejected if the market moves unfavorably.

tastyfx operates more like an STP-style setup than a traditional market maker. It is compensated through a hedging arrangement with IG Markets Ltd, which means client trades are hedged rather than the broker acting as the counterparty.

Tradable Instruments

tastyfx focuses exclusively on forex, and it does that well. U.S. traders get access to 86 spot currency pairs spanning majors, minors, and a deep mix of regional and emerging-market crosses. If you need one platform that covers most corners of the FX market, this checks the box. But if youâre looking to trade stocks, commodities, or crypto, tastyfx isnât the right fit.

What Can You Trade with tastyfx?

The lineup includes seven popular USD pairs, 26 non-USD crosses, strong coverage of Scandinavian currencies, and an unusually deep selection of emerging-market pairs. Together, this gives traders room to pursue a wide range of strategies, from fast-moving majors to more specialized regional trades.

In the tables below, you can see a selection highlighting the variety of currency pairs available to US traders:

Forex Major Forex Minor
EUR/USD | GBP/USD | USD/JPY | USD/CHF CAD/CHF | GBP/CAD | SGD/JPY | AUD/EUR

Forex Scandinavian Forex Emerging Markets
SEK/JPY | GBP/NOK | EUR/DKK | NOK/JPY USD/CNH | AUD/CNH | CNH/JPY | EUR/HUF

tastyfx Instruments: My Key Takeaways

The tastyfx lineup includes popular USD pairs, a solid selection of non-USD crosses, and standout depth in Scandinavian and emerging-market currencies. That breadth supports different styles: volatile pairs like GBP/JPY for active traders, steadier pairs like USD/CHF for slower-paced strategies, and higher-yield emerging markets for carry trades. Pairs such as AUD/JPY and NZD/JPY also make correlation strategies possible. However, the offering is strictly forex, which limits diversification within a single account.

Customer Support

tastyfx offers support through live chat, email, and phone from 3 a.m. Saturday to 5 p.m. Friday (ET). In my tests, responses were fast, and the support team was knowledgeable and helpful.

tastyfx Customer Support Test

Customer support is a critical part of any brokerâs offering, especially for new traders who need platform guidance and for experienced traders who require assistance fast during technical issues.

Over two weeks of testing, tastyfxâs support proved reliable. Live chat replies typically came in under a minute, email responses arrived the same day, and phone support was easy to reach. Questions about fees, platforms, and regulation were answered clearly and accurately, reflecting a support team that knows both the product and the market.
Deposit and Withdrawal

tastyfx supports deposits and withdrawals through bank wire, ACH, and debit cards (Visa and Mastercard). Processing times are in line with industry norms. Deposits are free, though bank wire withdrawals carry a $15 fee.

In the tables below, I break down the fees and processing times for each deposit and withdrawal method.

How Do You Deposit Money with tastyfx

Method Fees Processing Time
Debit Card (Visa, Mastercard) $0 Immediately once verified
Wire Transfer $0 Same-day processing
Bank Transfer (ACH) $0 Next business day when using Plaid verification, or 3-4 business days if manually verified

tastyfx lets you fund your account by debit card, wire transfer, or ACH bank transfer, and it doesnât charge deposit fees, though your bank may. ACH is the simplest option, with Plaid verification enabling quick setup and next-business-day deposits.

How Do You Withdraw Money from tastyfx

Method Fees Processing Time
Debit Card (Visa, Mastercard) $0 3-5 business days
Wire Transfer $15 Within 24 hours (same afternoon if requested before 12 p.m. EST)
Bank Transfer (ACH) $0 3-5 business days

Withdrawals can be made by debit card, ACH, or wire transfer, with card withdrawals capped at the amount originally deposited. Wire withdrawals carry a $15 fee. As with most brokers, funding methods must be verified, and withdrawals are typically returned to the original payment method.

Account Types and Terms

tastyfx offers a well-structured range of accounts for different trading styles. The Standard account uses spread-only pricing with no commissions, the Zero+ account offers raw spreads from 0.0 pips with a $5 per-lot commission, and the Prime account has tighter pricing with perks like interest on cash. Dedicated MetaTrader 4 and MetaTrader 5 accounts are also available.

How to Open an Account with tastyfx

Opening an account with tastyfx follows a standard U.S. brokerage process:

  1. Providing basic details such as your name, email, date of birth, phone number, address, and Social Security number.
  2. Provide information about your employment, income, net worth, trading experience, and how you plan to fund your account.
  3. Read and agree to the required regulatory disclosures.
  4. Verify your account with a driverâs license, state ID, or passport.

What Account Types tastyfx Offers

The Standard account is the easiest place to start, with no minimum deposit, no commissions, and broad platform support.

Zero+ is geared toward active traders who want ultra-tight spreads on major USD pairs and are willing to pay a commission.

Prime targets high-balance traders, combining tighter commission-free spreads, TradingView access, and cash interest. But keep in mind that the minimum deposit to open this account is $50,000.

Demo Account

Demo accounts are currently available via the tastyfx web platform, tastyfx mobile app, and MetaTrader 4, allowing you to practice your strategies and get comfortable without risking real money.

Islamic Account

One notable limitation is that tastyfx doesnât offer swap-free (Islamic) accounts. Traders who require Sharia-compliant trading will need to look elsewhere.

Margin and Leverage

One of the reasons that traders are attracted to the forex market is the high degree of available leverage. Leverage is the use of borrowed funds to increase the size of your trading positions beyond what would be possible using only the cash in your account. Leverage differs across asset classes and specific instruments.

In the table below, I cover the leverage available at tastyfx across a range of currency pairs.

Currency Pair Minimum Margin Required Per Contract Maximum Available Leverage
EUR/USD 2% 1:50
USD/CHF 3% 1:33
AUD/USD 3% 1:33
GBP/USD 5% 1:20
EUR/JPY 5% 1:20
USD/TRY 25% 1:4

tastyfx Supported Countries

tastyfx is available exclusively to U.S. residents. One exception is that accounts are not currently offered to residents of the state of Ohio.

Research

tastyfx shines in the research category with strong in-house analysis and third-party resources like Autochartist signals and a Thomson Reuters feed. The News section of the website contains regularly updated technical and fundamental research by seasoned analysts. Articles and videos are insightful and reflect the depth of experience youâd expect from an industry leader.

Coverage blends macro context, central-bank policy, and clear technical analysis, with articles that explain why a currency pair is moving. Pieces walk through jobs data, rate expectations, and technical setups in plain language. I liked that classic chart patterns are mentioned, for example, the recent Head and Shoulders in NZD/USD.

Reports are fairly short and accessible, providing both beginners and experienced traders with market context and trading ideas. While they are published on the website, you can also pull them via the web platform and mobile app while actively trading.

The economic calendar at tastyfx is clean, practical, and easy to use. It lets you track major market-moving events like FOMC decisions, Non-Farm Payrolls, and CPI releases, with filters for country and impact level. Each event includes historical data and actual-versus-expected results. Thereâs also coverage of earnings, dividends, splits, and IPOs live in separate tabs.

tastyfx Research: My Key Takeaways

Research output is consistent, with fresh analysis published daily from the in-house team. Combined with a high-quality Thomson Reuters news feed and Autochartist trading signals, tastyfx offers more depth than youâll find at most brokers, comfortably beating the industry average in this category.

Education

tastyfx keeps its educational content focused on the basics. There is a collection of articles that explain core forex concepts clearly. Written materials are supported by a solid library of beginner-friendly videos on the tastyfx YouTube channel. Still, the offering feels limited, and adding structured courses or live webinars would make the education lineup more competitive.

The educational articles on tastyfx focus on explaining forex clearly, without assuming prior knowledge. They cover the fundamentals like what forex trading is, how currency pairs work, and why traders are drawn to 24-hour markets and deep liquidity. The materials also break down majors vs. minors, pips, spreads, and lots. Beginner guides to forex charts and technical analysis explain how to read price movements and indicators in a practical, easy-to-follow way.

Readers also get explanations of order types, key market drivers like central banks, and economic data. While tastyfx has done a good job at a foundational level, I expected to see greater coverage of advanced topics like actionable strategies and automated trading.

The educational videos on the tastyfx YouTube channel focus on trading basics and platform know-how. From them, you can learn how to enter FX positions, which currency pairs move the most, when volatility peaks during the trading day, and how to manage profit expectations.

There are also several platform tutorials, covering the tastyfx web platform, MetaTrader 5, and TradingView. I was impressed by the eye for detail and the quality of these videos.

The Bottom Line

tastyfx is a forex-only broker built for U.S. traders who want a clean setup without giving up pro-grade tools. As a part of the well-established IG Group ,tastyfx offers a deep lineup of 86 currency pairs plus a genuinely strong platform menu: its own web platform and mobile app, MT4/MT5, TradingView, and ProRealTime.

On trust, it checks reassuring boxes: CFTC and NFA oversight, clear disclosures, and a parent company with real scale and history. However, U.S. retail forex comes with structural limits, including the absence of fund segregation and negative balance protection. Account safety at tastyfx is driven more by strict regulatory oversight, capital requirements, and transparency than by extra account-level safeguards.

Low fees are a major part of the appeal. My tests showed that spreads on major pairs are competitive and swap rates are better than average. Plus, high-volume traders can reduce costs further with rebates. Account options now span everything from a low-friction entry point (including a $1 minimum deposit) to more specialized pricing like the Zero+ account (raw spreads with a per-lot commission). Prime clients get perks like interest on idle cash (currently promotional).

I rate tastyfx as best suited for active forex trading styles. Day traders, scalpers, news traders, and algorithmic traders benefit from ultra-fast market execution, flexible pricing, advanced charting, and tools like Thomson Reuters news, Autochartist, and sentiment data.

Beginners can start with the clean web and mobile platforms and move to more advanced tools as they gain experience. The main limitations are a forex-only product lineup and a modest education section. All in all, for U.S. traders focused exclusively on spot forex, tastyfx remains a strong and well-rounded choice.

Our Take on tastyfx

tastyfx (formerly IG US) is a US-focused forex broker and part of the industry giant IG Group, which traces back to 1974. It is regulated by the National Futures Association (NFA) and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC), which together set a high bar for client protection in the US market.

Trading software is a strong point at tastyfx. The broker offers its own web platform and mobile app, as well as MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, TradingView, and ProRealTime. Positioning itself as a forex-only broker, tastyfx gives access to 86 currency pairs. While this represents a wider range of forex pairs than most competitors, tastyfx doesnât provide any instruments from other markets.

Since my last review, tastyfx has introduced several practical upgrades. The minimum deposit is now just $1, MetaTrader 5 accounts are available, and the Prime account earns interest on idle cash.

Active traders can also opt for the new Zero+ account, which offers raw spreads from 0.0 pips + commissions. For U.S.-based traders who want to trade forex and only forex, tastyfx stands out as a focused, well-regulated option with professional-grade tools.

Here are my findings on the various entities of Interactive Brokers:
